name: Gossip Corp
source:
It's hard to find a first opportunity when you just graduated from college, even more so when the worst storm in the last 40 years hits your city and you're late for your first interview.

But don't worry, fate is whimsical and makes you run into a couple of very attractive guys who work for the famous fashion magazine Gossip. Could this be your chance? What lies behind the mysterious and extravagant CEO? What is your relationship with the serious but kind editor? Although you might prefer a trip to the wild side with Mike, our rogue photographer, who also plays in a rock band! And to all this ... Don’t forget Hiro, your childhood friend, who seems to feel for you more than just friendship ...
translation:
当你刚从大学毕业时，很难找到第一次机会，更何况当过去40年来最严重的风暴袭击你的城市而你第一次面试迟到时更是如此。

但别担心，命运是反复无常的，让你遇到了几个非常有魅力的家伙，他们为著名的时尚杂志《Gossip》工作。这会是你的机会吗？神秘奢侈的CEO背后到底隐藏着什么？你和这位严肃但友善的编辑是什么关系？尽管你可能更喜欢与我们的流氓摄影师迈克一起去野外旅行，他也在摇滚乐队中演奏！对于这一切……不要忘记Hiro，你儿时的朋友，他对你的感觉似乎不仅仅是友谊……
